description: This PHP script handles activity reminders in the SugarCRM-based Calendar module. It manages reminder intervals, fetches upcoming reminders from the database, displays reminder popups, and updates reminder statuses.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for rendering reminder popups.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Base class for CRM entities, used here to retrieve activity info.

classes.name: SqlResultIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for database query results.

methods.name: ConvertToMinutes
methods.description: Converts reminder interval string to minutes.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Retrieves entity name based on module and record ID.

methods.name: getTranslatedString
methods.description: Translates a string based on current language settings.

methods.name: getaddEventPopupTime
methods.description: Calculates display time for event popups.
